quality_boundary: This Phase 14 inventory verifies Toyonaka's 2023-2027 latter basic plan, implementation-plan/digital-budget route, annual policy evaluation, FY2026 budget, and FY2024 settlement. It preserves municipal evaluation semantics and does not infer independent policy achievement, causal effects, fiscal effectiveness, or cross-city comparability.
